mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.slug, b.name, b.description, b.read_permission, b.write_permission, b.comment_enabled, b.attachment_enabled, b.active, b.sort_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.board_id = b.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS post_count, b.created_at FROM boards b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.sort_order ASC, b.id ASC
